summary.text: Stephanie Hein is a Democratic state representative who has represented Missouri House District 136 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A professor emerita of Missouri State University, she serves on the House Budget Committee.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Hein was born in Missouri and graduated from Hartville High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Missouri State University in 1995, a graduate degree from Missouri State in 2005, and a Ph.D. from the University of Missouri, Columbia in 2010.
Her career experience includes working in higher education.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a professor emerita at Missouri State University who previously headed its Department of Hospitality Leadership.
Hein was elected to District 136 in November 2022 and took office on January 4, 2023, succeeding J. Craig Fishel.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the Budget, Financial Institutions and Fiscal Review committees.
In the same survey, she said her priorities include public education, infrastructure, workforce development, and access to health care and mental health services.
